edges.reason: Attacker-controlled _target parameter flows directly into the delegatecall target.
Attacker-controlled _data parameter flows directly into the delegatecall calldata.
executeSwap executes the arbitrary delegatecall on the user-supplied target.
delegatecall returns returnData which is captured in the local variable.
delegatecall returns the success flag into the local success variable.
returnData is passed to decodeRevert when the delegatecall fails.
executeSwap conditionally invokes decodeRevert on delegatecall failure.
executeSwap calls safeTransferETH to pay the fee to the treasury.
The low-level value call to an untrusted recipient transfers control externally and may re-enter executeSwap before fees are recorded.
The external ETH transfer happens before the userFeeCharged state update, allowing reentrant fee-accounting manipulation.
The fee update writes into the userFeeCharged mapping state variable.
msg.sender is used as the key indexing userFeeCharged.
msg.sender is the key of the fee-accounting state update expression.
msg.sender is read inside executeSwap for accounting and the FeePayed event.
msg.sender is returned by the _msgSender Context helper.
_msgSender() is compared with owner() inside the onlyOwner modifier check.
owner() is read by the onlyOwner modifier to authorise the caller.
onlyOwner modifier guards the setTreasury function execution.
_treasury parameter is validated and assigned inside setTreasury.
setTreasury writes the new value into the treasury state variable.
Current treasury value is snapshotted into the local oldTreasury before replacement.
oldTreasury local is consumed by setTreasury when emitting TreasuryChanged.
onlyOwner modifier guards transferOwnership.
onlyOwner modifier guards renounceOwnership.
transferOwnership calls the private _setOwner helper.
renounceOwnership calls the private _setOwner helper with address(0).
_setOwner writes the new owner into the _owner state variable.
Constructor _treasury parameter is validated and stored.
The constructor initialises the treasury state variable.
The treasury address is supplied as the _to recipient of the fee transfer.
_to recipient parameter flows into the low-level value call.
_value amount parameter flows into the low-level value call.
_result bytes parameter is decoded and reverted inside decodeRevert.
Arbitrary delegatecall executes attacker code in the contract context and can overwrite the userFeeCharged storage mapping.
Arbitrary delegatecall can overwrite the _owner storage slot, taking over ownership of the contract.

normalization_plan.reason: The _treasury parameter is only meaningful as an input of setTreasury, so it collapses into that core function.
_target only exists to supply the target of the unsafe delegatecall operation.
_data only exists to supply the calldata of the unsafe delegatecall operation.
_to is only used as the recipient of the low-level value call in safeTransferETH.
_value is only used as the amount of the low-level value call in safeTransferETH.
_result is only consumed by the decodeRevert helper function.
The constructor _treasury parameter is a transient input of the constructor function.
returnData local only carries the delegatecall output into decodeRevert, so it collapses into that core function.
The success local is a transient flag local to executeSwap.
oldTreasury local is a transient snapshot used only inside setTreasury.
